Commentary.Commentary: ...THE CHASE...
England need 11 runs to win. May be an over or two required to chase it down. Stay tuned as the chase is coming up.

Josh Tongue leads the team as the debutant ends with a five-fer. England have done well to take the final wicket. They need an over so so now to finish things off. Credit to Ireland, for the way they played. Harry Tector, Mark Adair and the knock from Andy McBrine made sure England had to bat again. It was the stand between Adair and McBrine that made the big difference. The pitch was a flat one but England stuck to their plans and took the wicket when it mattered the most.
James McCollum has not recovered from the injury suffered and won't be able to participate any more with the bat. As it stands, James McCollum is retired out.

Commentary.Commentary: Another good session for Ireland! They have really done a comendable job to get into the lead! They have two people to thank for that and that is Andy McBrine and Mark Adair! The counter-attacking stand between them saw the two adding over 150. Mark Adair fell 15 short of a ton but Andy McBrine continued. He is now 15 short of a ton and has ensured his side go into the lead. He would hope Graham Hume hgangs around for a longer time and they can stretch this lead to as much as possible. England on the other hand, will be eager to take the last wicket and finish this game off quickly. Join us for what could be the last session of this game in a bit.

England are marching towards a win here. They started with Lorcan Tucker and Harry Tector being sensible but the former got out in the process. Tector got out as well just after reaching to his fifty. Now, Mark Adair and Andy McBrine have been batting aggressively and the plan is working out well for the Irish team. It will take more than that though to bat with the same plan against England who needed this break to recharge. Josh Tongue yet again was the man for them. He went short and kept it tight. Jack Leach too was decent. England will hope to wrap things in the next session while Ireland will hope these two bat for as long as possible.

It is going to be a long day for Ireland. A tough task awaits as they trail by 255 runs and are finding it difficult to sustain against the English bowlers. Tucker and Tector though have shown great determination to build a stand and need to continue to keep the game alive. We feel the first session will unfold all the stories. Stay tuned.

A day that belongs to England. Lorcan Tucker and Harry Tector have done really well though for Ireland to build a stand and make sure no more wickets fell. Early on, Ireland lost two wickets in no time. James McCollum was then retired hurt with an unfortunate injury. Paul Stirling too after getting a start failed to stick around. Credit to England as they bossed with the ball. The debutant, Josh Tongue in particularly as he was sharp and ended with three wickets. England are well and truly ahead in the game. They batted well on  Day 2, Ollie Pope in particular who scored a double-century. The others hung around and scored well too. England will hope to continue the good work with the ball on Day 3. They are 7 wickets away from the win. Ireland have a big job on their hand. Can they handle the pressure? We will find out together. Join us on Day 3 at 1530 IST (1000 GMT). Join us earl for the build up. Till then, cheers!
